rec.name: PDP Quantity Discounts (Volume Pricing)
rec.status: Built, tested and documented; handed to client (Jul 2025)

what.text: A PDP feature called "CRO | PDP | Mengenrabatte" (quantity discounts). Presumably the buyer picks a quantity tier on the product page and gets a lower unit price or a percentage discount for larger quantities. The ticket gives no UI or discount-logic details, so this description is inferred from the name.

why.text: Tiered pricing raises units per order and AOV. A visible "buy more, save more" offer anchors the buyer on a larger quantity. It also makes the saving concrete and easy to compare, which reduces the effort of deciding how many to buy. This is general CRO reasoning, not stated in the ticket.

how.text: Not documented in the ticket. The comments say documentation and testing were completed on 15 Jul 2025, but the content is not attached, so the build details need to be pulled from that documentation. A typical implementation is a tier selector in the buy box (e.g. 1 / 2 / 3+ units) that sets the quantity and shows the discounted price, with the discount applied via a Shopify automatic discount or a discount function.

items: Not specified in the ticket. Likely options: tier quantities, discount value per tier (% or fixed), default or preselected tier, and a highlight badge such as "Best value".

dependencies.text: Not specified. Probably needs a discount mechanism (automatic discount, discount function or an app) and possibly product metafields for tier configuration. This is unverified.

items: Margin per order (to monitor discount cost)
